Therefore a reduced FEV1:FVC ratio is present.Pulmonary fibrosis is a restrictive lung disease. In restrictive lung disease the total volume of air that can be forced out of the lungs is reduced (reduced FVC) however the first second volume of air forced out (FEV1) is less affected. Sentinel cells are a group of cells that reside in peripheral tissues and act as the first line of defence against infection. They are called sentinels because they are the first cells to encounter a pathogen, and can therefore detect the presence of microbes and initiate the immune response.  Sentinel cells include:Dendritic cellsLangerhans cellsMacrophagesMicroglial cells are essentially macrophages of the brain.  Natural killer cells are not sentinel cells, as they are not located in peripheral tissues, but rather circulate in the blood. They are part of the innate immune system, and are responsible for killing target cells that have been infected by a virus.

Aldosterone is a steroid hormone that is involved in the renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system (RAAS). It is released by the adrenal glands in response to decreased blood pressure. It increases sodium reabsorption and potassium secretion in the kidneys, which in turn increases blood pressure. It also stimulates the release of antidiuretic hormone (ADH) and growth hormone.
